subject: afi-dy
title: (R)AFI.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 103 ((AF)D-31). AFI-DY is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DE (information degrees). ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from the subject. From INFO-DE: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ATTN: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center). From DIS-C-CT: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and AFN (affinity negation). From AFN: AFI-DY-2. From AFI-DY-2: POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
